services.name: 5’4 LIFT5 Cruiser eFoil
services.desc: The 5’4 LIFT5 Cruiser is the most stable, forgiving, and beginner-friendly board in Lift’s Gen5 lineup - designed for relaxed rides, easy takeoffs, and smooth touchdowns. Whether you’re just learning, cruising the bay, or sharing the ride with family and friends, this setup makes it easy to get up and love every minute on the water. With the all-new Lift Connect System (LCS) and drop-in Gen5 battery, this eFoil delivers simplicity, safety, and performance in one super-smooth package. Note: LCS Jet uses more power than a folding prop. Ride time varies based on speed and rider weight. If you’re looking for comfort, stability, and the easiest way to start flying - the Cruiser is your ride.The

blurb: Guests can rent various watercraft including electric boats, kayaks, paddleboards, and eFoils, or book captained charter tours. Rentals include safety briefings and equipment such as life jackets for children under 12. The business operates at Safe Harbor Marina in Chula Vista, CA, offering guided and self-operated water experiences.

quotes.text: R and R Surf Rentals provided exceptional service! The staff was incredibly helpful in explaining the rental process, making our experience smooth and enjoyable. We can’t wait to return and try out one of their other water sport activities. Highly recommend for anyone looking for hassle-free rentals and excellent customer service!

They were awesome! Amazing customer service. Friendly staff. Patient and ready to explain and answer any questions. The hour kayak was perfect. They made the process easy and smooth and quick. We would recommend and definitely rent something again through R&R. Thank you

Highly recommend! We are looking to buy a Seadoo switch cruise and wanted to try one out before we purchase. The staff made things fast and easy for us. They answered all of our questions and were extremely helpful.
